recipes.title: Thick PB Chocolate Protein Ice Cream (Ninja Creami)

items.i: vanilla Greek yogurt, plus 1 big tbsp for the respin

steps: Mix the yogurt, powdered peanut butter, protein powder and milk really well in a Creami pint and freeze 24 hours.
Spin on the Smoothie Bowl setting — it will look powdery, which is what you want.
Dig a hole in the middle, add a big tablespoon of Greek yogurt and Re-spin until thick and creamy.
recipes.notes: Recipe from the video; whole-pint macros come from the on-screen nutrition card. The Greek yogurt base is what makes it thick like ice cream. Freezing time not included.
